title: leucanthemum gaudinii subsp. cantabricum
intro: Leucanthemum gaudinii subsp. cantabricum, commonly known as Cantabric Daisy, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Cantabric Daisy include its ability to soothe digestive issues, calm the nervous system, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
